description: Three units of a core frame and an extension substream whose asset has both a low bit rate (LBR) and a lossless (XLL) component.

skip.ffprobe_bitrate: ffmpeg's lossless decoder sets the bit rate to 0 (dca_xll.c: avctx->bit_rate = 0), so ffprobe lists none
skip.ffprobe_profile: ffmpeg's parser names a core with an extension substream by its XLL component first (dca_parser.c), so ffprobe reads DTS-HD MA where the analyzer names the stream by LBR first, as ffmpeg's decoder does (dcadec.c), which the stub LBR component does not allow it to confirm
